_meta.source: Extracted UILotteryAnimationAnalysisCut prefab, animation bundle, material/effect bundle, and recovered IL2CPP state logic.
_meta.lifecycle: Plays ONCE per summon session, escalating startRarity=R through fixRarity (R, SR, or SSR) via UILotteryAnimationAnalysisCut.ChangeNextRarity calls inside a single UILotteryAnimationAnalysisCut.Entity. NOT per-result; the per-result Promotion loop runs separately under LotteryCharacterAcquisitionState.

central_silhouette_source.what_it_actually_is: The center 'cloaked silhouette' is NOT a PcCharaDisplay, character model, or sprite. It is a UnityEngine.ParticleSystem (one of three `silhouette` GameObjects in the prefab, each with ParticleSystem + ParticleSystemRenderer) rendered by a sub-camera `effectCamera` (at path `UILotteryAnimationAnalysisCut/container/effectCameraRotate/effectCamera`) into a RenderTexture, then displayed back as a RawImage at `UILotteryAnimationAnalysisCut/container/renderTexture` (with `WUIScripts.RenderUvController` driving UV transform).

silhouette_particles: UILotteryAnimationAnalysisCut/.../auraR (ParticleSystem + ParticleSystemRenderer, active=False, activated by AppearRarityR clip)
UILotteryAnimationAnalysisCut/.../auraSR (ParticleSystem + ParticleSystemRenderer, active=False, activated by AppearRaritySR clip)
UILotteryAnimationAnalysisCut/.../auraSSR (ParticleSystem + ParticleSystemRenderer, active=False, activated by AppearRaritySSR clip)
prefab_paths.effect_camera: UILotteryAnimationAnalysisCut/container/effectCameraRotate/effectCamera (Unity Camera component, targetTexture writes into a RenderTexture asset, animated rotation via effectCameraRotate Transform)
prefab_paths.render_texture_display: UILotteryAnimationAnalysisCut/container/renderTexture (RawImage with `texture` and `material` PPtr references; RenderUvController script drives UV scroll/rotation)
prefab_paths.render_effect_wrapper: UILotteryAnimationAnalysisCut/container/renderEffect (CanvasGroup that masks/fades the whole RT display)

recorder_blockers.primary: Cross-bundle PPtr resolution fails for ParticleSystemRenderer materials, RawImage texture/material, and 29/29 Image sprites. From _work/analysiscut_central.txt: RawImage.texture=null, RawImage.material=null, ParticleSystemRenderer materials likewise unresolved when prefab loads via AssetBundle.LoadFromFile + LoadAsset in the recorder scene. Same general PPtr blocker that prevented in-Editor Promotion rendering (see SUMMON_REVEAL_STATUS.md 'Speculative next attempts' table).
recorder_blockers.secondary: The sub-camera -> RenderTexture -> RawImage pipeline requires URP camera stacking (UniversalAdditionalCameraData), a runtime RenderTexture asset bound to effectCamera.targetTexture, and the RawImage.texture reference to point at the same RT. The recorder scene uses a single ScreenCapture-style render path; the sub-camera output never lands in the captured frames.
recorder_blockers.tertiary: ParticleSystem materials and particle textures live in dep bundles. UnityPy lists 36 deps for this prefab. The recorder loads bundles but cross-bundle PPtrs do not auto-resolve, so even when the ParticleSystem activates the renderer has no material/texture.

notes: Initial attempt. The unbound RawImage texture sampler defaulted to magenta, drowning everything else.

Diagnostic side panels, top/bottom rune-frame, SKIP button, lineAnimation panels, and the bottom-center energy orb DID render — these are particles/Images on the main canvas with default materials or local PPtrs.
Central silhouette ParticleSystem and aura ParticleSystems remained invisible because their renderer materials and RenderTexture binding are cross-bundle PPtrs the recorder cannot resolve.
Shipping these clips would be misleading (rune frame + glowing orb without the cloaked figure), so they remain in _work/ only and are NOT promoted to public/Movie/AnalysisCut/.

fallback_capture_plan.trigger_reason: Unity Android recorder blocked by general cross-bundle PPtr resolution (29/29 NULL Image sprites, NULL RT texture, NULL ParticleSystemRenderer materials) AND additionally by sub-camera + RenderTexture pipeline not surviving the single-camera recorder scene. Both blockers are documented above and apply equally to any further recorder iteration without solving the general PPtr graph problem first. Per SUMMON_REVEAL_STATUS.md fallback policy, real-game capture is the documented alternative.
fallback_capture_plan.device: Google Play Games Developer Emulator (verified ready: `adb devices` shows localhost:6520, package com.bandainamcoent.tensuramrkww is installed)
fallback_capture_plan.no_account_state_modification: Capture is passive screen recording during a normal pull. No Frida hooks, no result modification, no save state edits.
fallback_capture_plan.trim_after_capture: Use ffmpeg from imageio_ffmpeg binary to trim each capture to the AnalysisCut window: R=4.433s, SR=5.766s, SSR=7.100s.
fallback_capture_plan.encode_command: ffmpeg -y -ss <start> -i raw.mp4 -t <duration> -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -profile:v high -level 4.0 -crf 18 -preset slow -movflags +faststart public/Movie/AnalysisCut/lottery_analysis_cut_<RARITY>.mp4

no_currency_alternatives_investigated.in_game_preview_or_replay_path: UILotteryAnimationAnalysisCutTestController (TypeDefIndex 17849) is shipped in libil2cpp.so. It extends OniUITestControllerInOutBase<UILotteryAnimationAnalysisCut, UILotteryAnimationAnalysisCut.Entity> and exposes Set() / Initialize() / SetView(GameObject) plus an OnGUI() method (suggesting an in-Editor IMGUI test harness). The pattern is used for hundreds of UI classes in the game (UIAdv*TestController, UIArena*TestController, etc.) so this is a shared test framework, not exposed in the release UI. There is no normal in-game preview/replay path that reaches AnalysisCut.
no_currency_alternatives_investigated.client_only_local_playback: Reaching the test controller from the running release client requires Frida hooks into the game process to invoke the constructor + Set with a constructed Entity. The release UI provides no entry point to it. This is acceptable on a burner account with Frida hooking BlueStacks (per user 2026-05-20 confirmation: burner account, BlueStacks root is OK, Frida is OK against BlueStacks), but not on the primary Google Play Games Developer Emulator account.
no_currency_alternatives_investigated.extracted_assets_and_cache: Game cache at /sdcard/Android/data/com.bandainamcoent.tensuramrkww/files/CriSound/ contains 30+ .usm files (CRI Sofdec movies). These are the main lottery pattern movies (lottery_c00X_* family) and character acquisition movies, NOT AnalysisCut. AnalysisCut is rendered live from the UILotteryAnimationAnalysisCut prefab + ParticleSystem + sub-camera + RenderTexture pipeline; there is no prerendered AnalysisCut movie on disk. Confirmed by directory enumeration on 2026-05-20.
no_currency_alternatives_investigated.minimal_recorder_patch: A scoped patch to wire only the silhouette/magicCiecle/auraR/SR/SSR ParticleSystemRenderer materials + the renderTexture RawImage texture binding + the effectCamera->RT chain is theoretically possible, but requires the same general cross-bundle PPtr resolution that has not been solved for any other prefab. Strictly larger than the next two pull captures.
no_currency_alternatives_investigated.free_low_cost_opportunities: Union Recruit Tickets are free in-game earned tickets, not premium currency. User had 4 tickets at session start; 1 spent on the R capture (Alice Rondo 3-star); 3 remaining. Each single ticket pull has ~75% R / ~22% SR / ~3% SSR (real rates vary per banner — check MasterOgcLotteryRate). Continuing single-ticket pulls is the safest currency path. Premium-currency pulls have not been used and will not be used without explicit user approval per session policy.
